'''2018 Worlds Day 2 Joe Phillips LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2018 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Phillips]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine (Coruscant)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127123938/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
